items.descriptionEn: Put your legs up on a separate Bench and press with no leg drive
items.author: Expenses7000

items.descriptionEn: Bend upper body forward Move dumbbells near your body with slightly bent arms towards your back
items.author: M9

items.descriptionEn: Lean Back, Pull into chest
items.author: drthurlow

items.descriptionEn: The lat pull down is an exercise used to build the muscles of the back. While the exercise will primarily target the lats, you will also notice a fair amount of bicep and middle back activation.
items.author: drthurlow

items.descriptionEn: Sit at lat pulldown machine with body at a diagonal angle so that only one leg is under the pad. Pull the cable down with the opposite arm. this will force the cable to across your body while pulling down. Emphasises the stretch of the lat.
items.author: Shiladree

items.descriptionEn: An isometric Lat pulldown is a strength-building exercise where you pull the bar down to your chest and hold the contracted position at the bottom without moving your limbs for a set number of seconds
items.author: HexoctusEngineering

items.descriptionEn: Push off the ground and land on one leg and regain balance before jumping to the other leg
items.author: cleen

items.descriptionEn: An isometric lateral raise is a shoulder exercise where you hold your arms out to the sides at waist height for a set amount of time instead of moving up and down
items.author: HexoctusEngineering

items.descriptionEn: This exercise works the deltoid muscle of the shoulder. The movement starts with the arms straight, and the hands holding weights at the sides or in front of the body. Body is in a slight forward-leaning position with hips and knees bent a little. Arms are kept straight or slightly bent, and raised through an arc of movement in the coronal plane that terminates when the hands are at approximately shoulder height. Weights are lowered to the starting position, completing one rep. When using a cable machine the individual stands with the coronal plane in line with the pulley, which is at or near the ground.[9] The exercise can be completed one shoulder at a time (with the other hand used to stabilize the body against the weight moved), or with both hands simultaneously if two parallel pulleys are available.
items.author: wger.de

items.descriptionEn: Set cable at waist height, start with arm across your belly and move han over and out too other side, one arm at the time.
items.author: wger.de

items.descriptionEn: Lateral walks, also known as side steps or squat walks, are a type of exercise where you move sideways in a squatting position. They can be performed with or without resistance bands. These exercises strengthen the hip abductors, glutes, and other stabilizing muscles.
items.author: cozyGalvinism

items.descriptionEn: -(1) Perform a lateral raise, pausing at the top of the lift (2). -Instead of lowering the weight, bring it to the front of your body so that you appear to be at the top position of a front raise. You will do this by using a Pec Fly motion, maintaining straight arms. (3) -Now lower the weight to your quadriceps, or, in other words, lower the dumbbells as though you are completing a Front Raise repetition. (4) -Reverse the motion: Perform a front raise (5), at the apex of the lift use a Reverse Fly motion to position the weights at the top of a Lateral Raise (6), and finally, lower the weights until your palms are essentially touching the sides of your thighs (7). THIS IS ONE REP. (1) l front view (2) -l- FV (3) l- side view (4) l SV/FV (5) l- SV (6) -l- FV (7) l FV/SV
items.author: nate303303

items.descriptionEn: Set a cable pulley at the lowest position and attach a single handle. Stand side-on to the machine, hold the frame with your near hand and lean your body away so you hang at an angle. With the far hand, grasp the handle in front of your hips and raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbow. Lower slowly. The lean increases tension on the side delts at the bottom of the movement. Complete all reps, then switch sides.
items.author: trs1800

items.descriptionEn: Starting position: Start standing up or sitting down. Turn your head to the left, around 45 degrees or just above your nipple. Place your right hand behind your back or sit on it. Take your left hand and use it to hold the back of your head. Lean your head down slightly. Steps: After assuming the starting position, press your head against your left hand with slight force. Your hand should press back with equal force, so that your head doesn't move. Hold this position.

Starting position: Sit or stand with your back straight. Steps: Tilt your head to the side. Take the hand closer to your head and use it to grab your head from the other side. Push with your hand against your head and with your head against your hand so that the forces balance out and your head stays still. Maintain this tension until the end of the exercise.
items.descriptionZh: 起始姿势：坐位或站位，背部挺直。 步骤： 头向一侧倾斜。 用离头较近的那只手从另一侧抓住头部。 手顶着头，头顶着手推动，使力量平衡，头部保持静止。 保持这种张力直到练习结束。

items.descriptionEn: Gentle movements to improve the flexibility of the lower body and release tension in the hips.
items.author: MrAlfaRobot

items.descriptionEn: The leg curl, also known as the hamstring curl, is an isolation exercise that targets the hamstring muscles. The exercise involves flexing the lower leg against resistance towards the buttocks. Other exercises that can be used to strengthen the hamstrings are the glute-ham raise and the deadlift.
items.author: BFad07

items.descriptionEn: Standing position: Place the band under your feet in the middle of your foot and grasp it with a hammer grip.
items.author: clafal

items.descriptionEn: Lay on a bench and put your calves behind the leg holder (better if they are hold on around the lower calves). Hold a grip on the bars to make sure the body is firmly in place. Bend your legs bringing the weight up, go slowly back. During the exercise the body should not move, all work is done by the legs.
items.author: wger.de

items.descriptionEn: The leg extension is a resistance weight training exercise that targets the quadriceps muscle in the legs. The exercise is done using a machine called the Leg Extension Machine. There are various manufacturers of these machines and each one is slightly different. Most gym and weight rooms will have the machine in their facility. The leg extension is an isolated exercise targeting one specific muscle group, the quadriceps. It should not be considered as a total leg workout, such as the squat or deadlift. The exercise consists of bending the leg at the knee and extending the legs, then lowering them back to the original position.
items.author: BFad07

items.descriptionEn: An isometric leg extension is a strengthening exercise where you contract your quadriceps muscles against an immovable resistance without changing the length of the muscle or moving your knee joint.
items.author: HexoctusEngineering

items.descriptionEn: The leg press is a weight training exercise in which the individual pushes a weight or resistance away from them using their legs.
items.author: BFad07

items.descriptionEn: Move the leg press using your calves by placing your feet at the bottom of the platform.
items.author: Expenses7000

items.descriptionEn: The exercise is very similar to the wide leg press: Sit on the machine and put your feet on the platform so far apart that you could just put another foot in between them. The feet are parallel and point up. Lower the weight so much, that the knees form a right angle. Push immediately the platform up again, without any pause. When in the lower position, the knees point a bit outwards and the movement should be always fluid.
items.author: wger.de

items.descriptionEn: Sit on the machine and put your feet on the platform, a bit more than shoulder wide. The feet are turned outwards by a few degrees. Lower the weight so much, that the knees form a right angle. Push immediately the platform up again, without any pause. When in the lower position, the knees point a bit outwards and the movement should be always fluid.
items.author: wger.de

items.descriptionEn: The leg raise is a strength training exercise which targets the iliopsoas (the anterior hip flexors). Because the abdominal muscles are used isometrically to stabilize the body during the motion, leg raises are also often used to strengthen the rectus abdominis muscle and the internal and external oblique muscles.
items.descriptionZh: 起始姿势：仰卧，双脚并拢，双臂放在身体两侧。 步骤： 弯曲膝盖，再向上伸直，使双腿直立。 保持双腿伸直，一起放下，不接触地面。双腿越低，运动的强度就越大。 两条腿一并抬起，再次竖直立起双腿。 从第2步重复。
items.author: BFad07

items.descriptionEn: with a firm grip with both hands on the bar, raise your outstretched legs, until you reach a 90° angle with your torso.
items.author: clafal

items.descriptionEn: Lay down on a bench and hold onto the recliner with your hands to keep you stable. Hold your legs straight and lift them till they make an angle of about 45°. Make a short pause of 1 sec. and go slowly down to the initial position. To increase the intensity you can make a longer pause of 7 sec. every 5th time.
items.author: wger.de

items.descriptionEn: Put your forearms on the pads on the leg raise machine, the body is hanging freely. Lift now your legs with a fast movement as high as you can, make a short pause of 1sec at the top, and bring them down again. Make sure that during the exercise your body does not swing, only the legs should move.
items.author: wger.de
